name: -8 AN to M24x1.5mm Metric Adapter
title: -8 AN to M24x1.5mm Metric Adapter
description:
The -8 AN to M24x1.5mm Metric Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to Metric Adapter and Union Fittings are precision-engineered to connect metric female ports to AN flare fittings, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
